main_text.p: tate ingenii,partim tædio peregrinationis evicti,dedere le adverfarius, iam poft redi-tum legatoru fuperioribus: & ecclesiam noltris inde detrufis obtinentibus.factaq; femel inclinatione animorum,catervatim in partem alteram concelsum : donec ad viginti ufq; noftrorum numerus immi-nutus eft. Sed hi quanto pauciores,tanto validiores erant. conftantifsimulq; inter epifco-eos habebatur nofter Fægadius pu Agin- nenfis, & Ser-vatio Tungrorum epifcopus. hos, quia quem alijminis & terriculis non celserant, Taurus Fœbadiu appellant, & meli-precibus aggreditur,ac lachrymans obte-ratur, mitiora uti confulerent. Claulos ws.intra unam urbem epifcopos jam lepti-mum menfem agere: injuria hyemis & inopia confectis, nullam fpem reversio-nis dari: quis tandem elset finis? feque. rentur plurium exemplum,auctoritatem faltem ex numero fumerent. Etenim ve-to Fægadius paratum fe exilio atque ad omne fupplicium,in quod depofceretur, profiteri:fe ab Arrianis conceptam fidem non recepturum. Ita in hoc certamine b profici-aliquot dies tracti, ubi parum ad pacem{b} proficiebant, paulatim & ipfe infractior, ad extremum propositá conditione evin-citur.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are partly cut or blurred; their readings (such as "pu Agin- nenfis," "quem alij," "Fœbadiu appellant," "that.Sig.") are uncertain and may be inexact. The page number "138" and the marks "a" and "b" are doubtful. The word "Fægadius" is followed by a superscript mark that may be a note reference. The note line "that.Sig." is faint and not transcribed. The word "le" in "dedere le adverfarius" may be "ie". The word "Ser-vatio" is printed as "Servatio" across a line break. The word "Taurus" and the words "Claulos" and "epifcopos" may be printing variants. Line-end hyphens are as printed. The first paragraph continues from the previous page.
